captions.detailed: A compact laboratory monocular microscope featuring a rectangular grey base, a vertical guide column, a swept arm, a monocular viewing head, and a black rectangular slide stage. The stage is equipped with a projecting slide carriage that translates prismatically left-to-right. The entire arm and viewing head assembly slides prismatically up and down on the vertical guide, controlled by twin black focus knobs that rotate on a shared horizontal shaft.
captions.instruction: Generate a compact laboratory monocular microscope with a rectangular base, a vertical guide column, a swept arm, and a rectangular slide stage. Ensure the slide carriage translates prismatically from left to right, the viewing head carriage slides vertically on the guide column, and twin focus knobs rotate on a shared horizontal shaft.
captions.factory: Construct the microscope using an assembly of parts. Model the base, vertical guide, and stage support as fixed parts using box primitives. Create a vertical sliding carriage using a box and cylinder representing the focus knobs and shaft. Model the stage as a black box with a prismatic joint for the slide carriage. Finally, build the viewing head and objective lenses using cylinders and boxes, and attach them to the vertical slider.
